extDescription.message: Lists the canvases on the current page and downloads them as PNG.

noCanvasTitle.message: There is no canvas on this page.

noCanvasDetail.message: If the drawing appears after loading, wait a few seconds and open the extension again.

exportError.message: Cannot export (canvas with images from another domain, or WebGL without a preserved drawing buffer).

noActiveTabDetail.message: Open the page with the canvases and click the icon again.

restrictedDetail.message: Chrome does not let extensions read its internal pages or the Chrome Web Store. Open a page with a canvas.

fileDetail.message: To read local files, turn on “Allow access to file URLs” in chrome://extensions, or open the page from a local server.

readErrorTitle.message: This page could not be read.

readErrorDetail.message: Reload the tab and open the extension again. If it still fails, the extension may have been loaded from a folder that no longer exists (load it again in chrome://extensions).
